title: Northwind Rebuild · The Ten-Week Plan

replacements.label: figure 1: the document chain
replacements.find: This plan sits on top of the brief, the discovery notes and the estimate.
replacements.replace:
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  B[The brief] --> D[Discovery notes]
  D --> E[The estimate]
  E --> P[This plan]
```

replacements.label: figure 2: the system
replacements.find: The shape of the system is four parts and one queue.
replacements.replace:
```mermaid
flowchart TB
  subgraph Front
    W[Web client]
  end
  subgraph Core
    S[Service tier] --> Q[(Work queue)]
    Q --> R[(Reporting store)]
  end
  W --> S
```

replacements.label: figure 3: one order end to end
replacements.find: An order takes six hops from the shop front to the ledger.
replacements.replace:
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Customer
  participant W as Web client
  participant S as Service tier
  participant L as Ledger
  C->>W: places an order
  W->>S: submits it
  S->>L: posts the entry
  L-->>C: confirmation
```
